The '''Shalm system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Ikenomin sector/Legends|Ikenomin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shalm]].<ref name="Cracken">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref>
